text: 证监会官网IPO辅导公示系统显示，九州云箭空间科技股份有限公司已在上海证监局办理辅导备案登记，辅导机构为国泰海通证券。
text_en: The CSRC's official website IPO tutoring disclosure system shows that JiuZhou YunJian Space Technology Co., Ltd. has completed tutoring registration with the Shanghai Securities Regulatory Bureau, with Guotai Haitong Securities as the tutoring institution.
